statements.text: In the second scenario, since both the stator core and the rotor core are produced in Korea, the country origin of the stator-rotor assembly will be Korea.

Accordingly, we find that in Scenario 1, for purposes of determining the applicability of 301 trade remedy dutes, since both the rotor core and stator core are of Chinese origin, the country of origin of the stator-rotor assembly will be China.
The components used in making the rotor and stator assemblies will come from various countries, as set forth below, and the assemblies will be manufactured in either China, Mexico, or Korea.
